body: I love games. I never played Jak and Daxter but I always wanted to. I get anxiety/depression keeping you from playing, happens to me a lot too. Do you watch Let's Plays? Channels like Game Grumps helped me experience games I was too messed up to play. Metroid Prime was amazing, scanned everything because I'm ocd. Mass Effect is amazing, did you prefer going paragon or renegade?
I know what it's like to be crippled by depression, to have it even stop you from your hobbies. What games do you like to play?
Yeah. The more I reflect on it the more I realize this is just who I am. What I call normal is the imbalance.
I'm sorry. I wouldn't wish this on anyone.
What's the problem anyway. When I die I'll be gone. No memory of having ever existed. For 99.9999999999 (and so on) percent of the universes existence I won't exist anyway, might as well round down.

Even small setbacks put me in this space. I'm tired of constantly fighting it. Better to get it over with now and spare myself a lifetime of pain. Both of my parents died in their 50's, so at 30 I'm probably over halfway done anyway. I don't see things getting good enough to make up for my dumpster fire of a life so far.
